get.description: Combined hourly (precipitation, soil moisture at 0-1cm/1-3cm/3-9cm depth) and current-conditions lookup for a coordinate in Pakistan or Uzbekistan. Cached and Cloudflare edge-accelerated; not spatially interpolated, since Open-Meteo already resolves it from its nearest NWP model grid point.

parameters.name: pastDays
parameters.description: Number of past days of hourly history to include

parameters.name: forecastDays
parameters.description: Number of forecast days of hourly data to include

get.description: Retrieves past weather records for any location in Pakistan. Supports previous full year (e.g. year=2024), custom date ranges (startDate & endDate), daily/hourly aggregations, and climate summaries.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to 365 days ago if not provided)

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to 5 days ago / yesterday if not provided)

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: Shortcut to fetch full year historical data (e.g. 2024 will query 2024-01-01 to 2024-12-31)

parameters.name: aggregate
parameters.description: Aggregation granularity: daily (default), hourly, or summary only

parameters.name: elevation
parameters.description: Target altitude in meters above sea level for 3D elevation adjustments

parameters.name: interpolate
parameters.description: Allow spatial interpolation fallback if needed

400.description: Coordinates outside Pakistan coverage, invalid dates, or invalid query parameters.
